sources.games: 1537 league games since 7.41 (data/heroes/item_stats), win 52.8%. Reproduce: python scripts/hero_item_stats.py ember_spirit. Read as a mid (lane_role 2): 52 high-rank games as a carry were too few; the same plan serves a carry Ember.
sources.hero: Valve /datafeed/herodata hero_id 106 (Sleight of Fist, Flame Guard, Fire Remnant), 7.41f.
sources.player: Player review, 2026-10-20: no Spirit Vessel for offlaners against heavy healing (a support's item); Linken's Sphere for Queen of Pain, Puck, Void Spirit and Storm Spirit against Phantom Assassin and Spirit Breaker, not Slark; Axe levels Battle Hunger second; Templar Assassin keeps Meld > Psi Blades > Refraction.

rules.name: Spirit Vessel
rules.basis: Valve 7.41f Spirit Vessel: Soul Release on an enemy cuts its health restoration by 70% and drains 4% of its current health per second for 8 s (10 s cooldown, charges from hero deaths within 1500). It is in his build (Urn of Shadows 66% at ~8 min, Spirit Vessel 62% at ~13 min of the won games).

build_basis: Assembled items bought in 25%+ of the won games, by median minute: magic_wand 96% (4), ward_dispenser 30% (5), urn_of_shadows 66% (8), phase_boots 90% (8), spirit_vessel 62% (13), pers 63% (14), mage_slayer 58% (16), kaya 59% (20), veil_of_discord 28% (23), aghanims_shard 86% (24), black_king_bar 53% (25), sange 42% (28), kaya_and_sange 40% (29), bloodstone 20% (29), ultimate_scepter 64% (32), soul_booster 30% (32), shivas_guard 30% (34).

tempo.basis: Gold lines where the hero wins 85.0%+: 20:00 12500 (21 games, 85.7%), 25:00 15500 (58 games, 87.9%), 30:00 18500 (85 games, 87.1%); net worth ~0.96 of that gold; points under 20 games left out.

suppress.break: Silver Edge is not his item: his damage is Sleight of Fist, Flame Guard and Fire Remnant; high-rank Embers never build it (Bloodstone 25% against break heroes, 17% otherwise).
suppress.illusions: As a carry: Sleight of Fist hits every unit in up to 550 radius and Flame Guard burns around him, so illusions fall without Maelstrom.
